basis: Visual inspection of all five pages of review.pdf generated from original observations; no reference figure inspected for this review. Qualitative observations are not phase ground truth. Event indices refer to b00267a baseline outputs.

findings.note: The S-only association places several S picks after the strongest visible wave packet. CPOZ has a sharp onset about 4.5 s after the provisional origin but its assigned S is around 9.5 s. Possible coda mis-picks; no accepted event or depth.

Several stations show a coherent onset around 4.5 s; CSOC has S before P on earlier energy. At least one pair is causally inconsistent; this does not establish that all phases or the event itself are false.
The lower-bound event contains visible arrivals before the fitted origin at CPOZ and other stations. Its fitted origin/depth cannot be accepted as physical.
The upper-bound event includes sustained oscillatory energy at several stations and no convincing common P onset in this display; requires further review, not a verified 8 km earthquake.

Many stations show clear P onsets and later larger horizontal arrivals near the independent picks. This supports a real recorded event qualitatively, but neither phase accuracy nor depth is independently calibrated.

selection: One example per prescribed category, selected by largest pick count then lowest event index; not a random validation sample.
